title: 10 Small Deaths a Godly Man Chooses Before Breakfast
caption:
10 small deaths a godly man chooses before breakfast.

Luke 9:23 was never a one-time thing. Take up your cross daily, not once at an altar call and never again.

The snooze button. The comeback he wants to text back. The excuse that's technically true. None of them look like much on their own. That's exactly why they don't get a vote.

Paul called it dying daily, not dying once (1 Corinthians 15:31).
